cards.name: Oracle's Attendants
cards.oracleText: {T}: All damage that would be dealt to target creature this turn by a source of your choice is dealt to this creature instead.

cards.name: Oracle's Vault
cards.oracleText:
{2}, {T}: Exile the top card of your library. Until end of turn, you may play that card. Put a brick counter on this artifact.
{T}: Exile the top card of your library. Until end of turn, you may play that card without paying its mana cost. Activate only if there are three or more brick counters on this artifact.

cards.name: Coiling Oracle
cards.oracleText: When this creature enters, reveal the top card of your library. If it's a land card, put it onto the battlefield. Otherwise, put that card into your hand.

cards.name: Dark-Dweller Oracle
cards.oracleText: {1}, Sacrifice a creature: Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn. (You still pay its costs. You can play a land this way only if you have an available land play remaining.)

cards.name: Doomskar Oracle
cards.oracleText:
Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, you gain 2 life.
Foretell {W} (During your turn, you may pay {2} and exile this card from your hand face down. Cast it on a later turn for its foretell cost.)

cards.name: Etched Oracle
cards.oracleText:
Sunburst (This creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it for each color of mana spent to cast it.)
{1}, Remove four +1/+1 counters from this creature: Target player draws three cards.

cards.name: Incendiary Oracle
cards.oracleText:
{1}{R}: This creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
If a creature dealt damage by this creature this turn would die, exile it instead.

cards.name: Jadzi, Steward of Fate // Oracle's Gift
cards.oracleText:
Jadzi enters prepared. (While it's prepared, you may cast a copy of its spell. Doing so unprepares it.)
When Jadzi enters, draw two cards, then discard two cards.
Create X 0/0 green and blue Fractal creature tokens, then put X +1/+1 counters on each Fractal you control.

cards.name: Naga Oracle
cards.oracleText: When this creature enters, surveil 3. (Look at the top three cards of your library, then put any number of them into your graveyard and the rest on top of your library in any order.)

cards.name: Oracle of the Alpha
cards.oracleText:
Flying
When Oracle of the Alpha enters the battlefield, conjure the Power Nine into your library, then shuffle.
Whenever Oracle of the Alpha attacks, scry 1.

cards.name: Oracle's Insight
cards.oracleText:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature has "{T}: Scry 1, then draw a card." (To scry 1, look at the top card of your library, then you may put that card on the bottom.)

cards.name: Thassa's Oracle
cards.oracleText: When this creature enters, look at the top X cards of your library, where X is your devotion to blue. Put up to one of them on top of your library and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. If X is greater than or equal to the number of cards in your library, you win the game. (Each {U} in the mana costs of permanents you control counts toward your devotion to blue.)

cards.name: Oracle of Mul Daya
cards.oracleText:
You may play an additional land on each of your turns.
Play with the top card of your library revealed.
You may play lands from the top of your library.

cards.name: Storm God's Oracle
cards.oracleText:
{1}: This creature gets +1/-1 until end of turn.
When this creature dies, it deals 3 damage to any target.

cards.name: Sandstone Oracle
cards.oracleText:
Flying
When this creature enters, choose an opponent. If that player has more cards in hand than you, draw cards equal to the difference.

cards.name: Seafloor Oracle
cards.oracleText: Whenever a Merfolk you control deals combat damage to a player, draw a card.

cards.name: Prayer of Binding
cards.oracleText:
Flash
When this enchantment enters, exile up to one target nonland permanent an opponent controls until this enchantment leaves the battlefield. You gain 2 life.

cards.name: Oracle's Restoration
cards.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +1/+1 until end of turn. You draw a card and gain 1 life.

cards.name: Sea Gate Oracle
cards.oracleText: When this creature enters, look at the top two cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the other on the bottom of your library.

cards.name: Primal Prayers
cards.oracleText:
When this enchantment enters, you get {E}{E} (two energy counters).
You may cast creature spells with mana value 3 or less by paying {E} rather than paying their mana costs. If you cast a spell this way, you may cast it as though it had flash.

cards.name: Oracle of Dust
cards.oracleText:
Devoid (This card has no color.)
{2}, Put a card an opponent owns from exile into that player's graveyard: Draw a card, then discard a card.

cards.name: Oracle of Bones
cards.oracleText:
Haste
Tribute 2 (As this creature enters, an opponent of your choice may put two +1/+1 counters on it.)
When this creature enters, if tribute wasn't paid, you may cast an instant or sorcery spell from your hand without paying its mana cost.

cards.name: Oracle en-Vec
cards.oracleText: {T}: Target opponent chooses any number of creatures they control. During that player's next turn, the chosen creatures attack if able, and other creatures can't attack. At the beginning of that turn's end step, destroy each of the chosen creatures that didn't attack this turn. Activate only during your turn.

cards.name: Oracle of Tragedy
cards.oracleText:
When this creature enters or dies, choose one —
• Draw a card, then discard a card.
• Shuffle up to four target cards with mana value 3 or greater from your graveyard into your library.

cards.name: Oracle of Nectars
cards.oracleText: {X}, {T}: You gain X life.

cards.name: Rhox Oracle
cards.oracleText: When this creature enters, draw a card.

cards.name: War Oracle
cards.oracleText:
Lifelink (Damage dealt by this creature also causes you to gain that much life.)
Renown 1 (When this creature deals combat damage to a player, if it isn't renowned, put a +1/+1 counter on it and it becomes renowned.)

cards.name: Sheltering Prayers
cards.oracleText: Basic lands each player controls have shroud as long as that player controls three or fewer lands. (They can't be the targets of spells or abilities.)

cards.name: Oracle
cards.oracleText: {0}: Untap target attacking creature you control and remove it from combat.
